features.text: Advanced lateral pressure plate system allows customizable compression to control patellar movement and reduce subluxation risk
Premium neoprene construction delivers therapeutic warmth while supporting post-operative healing and rehabilitation
Adjustable compression technology lets you fine-tune the support level based on your activity and comfort needs
Anatomically designed to create an effective soft tissue wall for optimal patella tracking during movement
Targeted support system helps reduce pain and discomfort associated with chronic patellar conditions
